 Order

The present appeal preferred by the claimant under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act seeks enhancement of compensation awarded by the learned Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, vide its award dated 23.12.2022.
2. Upon the appellants taking steps, issue notice to the respondents through all permissible modes.
3. Reply, if any, to the application be filed within six weeks.
Rejoinder thereto, if any, be filed within four weeks thereafter.
4. The TCR be requisitioned and digitized before the next date.
This is a digitally signed order.
